text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The day is growing late as Symboli<n>Rudolf and I
head back after our day<n>out.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
If you wouldn't mind, there's<n>somewhere I would
like to drop by<n>before we return to the academy.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Would you be willing to accompany<n>me?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
The moon is supposed to be a perfect<n>crescent
tonight, and I hear that the<n>sky will be clear...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Rudolf leads me to a shrine<n>located on a
small hill.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
There aren't any buildings or bright<n>lights around
here. We should have a<n>perfect view.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Perfect is right. A beautiful crescent<n>moon shines
brightly in the sky above<n>us.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I rarely speak about this, but...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
When I was young, I was often called<n>Luna, on
account of the white streak<n>in my hair.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
You could hardly imagine it now, could<n>you? But it
suited me then.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I always loved the sound of it, and<n>once I learned
where it came from, I<n>smiled every time I caught
sight of the<n>moon.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...But that's in the past now.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I left that name behind when I<n>resolved to walk the
path of the<n>Emperor.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: That isn't to say I mourn its loss, you<n>understand.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I can't explain why, but... I simply felt<n>that you
ought to know.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I can't explain why, but... I simply felt<n>that you
ought to know.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I'm glad that you were so willing to<n>listen.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I feel... How should I put it?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
It's as if a burden has been lifted<n>from my
shoulders. My heart feels as<n>clear as the night air.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...We ought to head back.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I'm counting on you, Trainer.<n>Tomorrow and
beyond...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
With the memory she shared still<n>fresh in my
mind, I quietly swear to<n>stay by Symboli Rudolf's
side.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Hah. Be that as it may, call me that in<n>public and
you'll sound like a lunatic.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Call me Luna, and you'll sound like...<n>Pffft. That's
rather good.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Luna... Lunatic...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
That's some quality wordplay.<n>Perfect for an
inside joke between<n>comrades.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
We walk back to the academy under<n>the
moonlight, with Symboli Rudolf<n>stifling giggles all
the while.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: That... means a lot to me.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
It's reassuring to think that, even<n>after I have
walked my path to its end<n>and made my dreams a
reality...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: You will still remember who I used to<n>be.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Knowing that, I can forge ahead all the<n>stronger.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Symboli Rudolf smiles in the<n>moonlight.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I swear to myself that I will stay by<n>her side, come
what may.
